blocks.text: Dimensionality can be used to derive a possible formula for a physical quantity by correct estimation of various factors on which the quantity depends.

Derive a formula for the centripetal force required to keep an object moving along a circle with uniform speed. Assuming that centripetal force depends on mass of the object, radius of the circle and uniform speed.
